flags.title: OLBG 'Skanderborg vs FC Barcelona' conflicts with the EHF official schedule
flags.body: The OLBG handball row (event 12137, tip 'Skanderborg Handbold' 5.50) names Skanderborg as the home side of the 29 Oct Champions League fixture involving FC Barcelona. The EHF official schedule lists that fixture as SAH Aarhus vs Barca at 20:45 CEST. The rows are treated as a different-identity conflict: no pick is published on it, and the EHF link is attached for manual review.

flags.title: OLBG start times disagree with official schedules in several sports
flags.body: Systematic finding from cross-walking: the WS G4 OLBG display (21:00) vs MLB official gameDate 2026-10-28T00:00Z; cricket OLBG '03:00 UK' labels vs payload unix timestamps (07:00Z etc.) and ICC viewer-zone times; Pro D2 OLBG payload timestamps (e.g. Dax 30 Oct 04:00Z) vs LNR official 29 Oct 21:00 CEST; EHF OLBG '15:45' vs EHF 20:45 CEST. The desk treats each sport's official source as the time authority and flags every affected row; official times are shown on the rows where captured.

flags.title: OLBG handball rows are 3-way 'Tie' (draw) tips at 7/1 to 27/1
flags.body: Most OLBG handball hub rows display the selection 'Tie' in the Money Line market (e.g. Magdeburg-Kriens 16.00, Kielce-Kolstad 20.00, PSG-Aalborg 8.50). The picks published for handball are therefore explicit draw selections in a three-way money line, labeled as such on every row. This is what OLBG displays; it is not a desk interpretation, but readers should not read these as team-winner picks.

flags.title: Snooker and greyhounds have zero OLBG events today; rugby league is ante-post only
flags.body: The Snooker hub returned 'No tips found' (0 events) and the Greyhounds hub returned 0 events on 2026-10-27. The Rugby League hub holds only three 2027 ante-post lines (State of Origin, Super League GF winner, NRL winner) with no live fixtures. These shortfalls are reported as-is; no rows or picks are invented to fill the 5-per-sport target.

flags.title: Some rows are listed without a captured price (payload window ended mid-hub)
flags.body: The sandbox capture read the first price-bearing rows of each hub's hydration payload; rows beyond the captured window (e.g. most tennis, some cricket, volleyball, basketball, rugby) are listed with identity and flags but a blank price. The background collector on the session branch is the refresh channel for the full grid; every blank price is flagged on its row rather than filled.
